info.title: Kuutti API
info.description: Free, non-commercial dating app for Finland. Every account is verified through a Finnish bank. Source: AGPL-3.0 with App Store exception.

get.summary: Liveness and readiness in one answer
get.description: 200 when the database answers and committed migrations are applied; 503 with the same body when either fails.
Opened in the system browser by the app. Redirects to the identification broker's bank chooser; the person comes back through /auth/callback and the app receives a one-time code by deep link.

schema.description: The app that will receive the one-time code by deep link.

parameters.description: The app that will receive the one-time code by deep link.
parameters.name: platform

schema.description: The language of the bank chooser (ui_locales); defaults to the request's.

parameters.description: The language of the bank chooser (ui_locales); defaults to the request's.
parameters.name: locale

get.description: The registered redirect URI. Exchanges the code with the broker, derives the identity, applies the re-registration rule and redirects to the app's deep link with a one-time code. Never called by the app itself.

302.description: Redirect to kuutti://auth?code=… on success, or to kuutti://auth?error=<code> (auth_state_mismatch, auth_cancelled, auth_under_18, auth_banned, auth_suspended, auth_cooldown with &until=<date>, auth_provider_error) so the app shows the refusal.

post.summary: Exchange the one-time code for a session
post.description: Single use, within 60 seconds of the callback. Answers with this device's access and refresh tokens; the app keeps both in secure storage.
Presents the refresh token, receives a new pair; the old refresh token is retired. Presenting a retired token ends the device's session (session_revoked): sign in through the bank again.

401.description: Retired, revoked, expired or unknown refresh token (session_revoked).

204.description: The session is ended; both tokens stop working.

post.description: Recovery for a lost phone: every session of the account ends, including this one.

204.description: Every session of the account is ended.

get.description: Opened by the moderation panel. The same bank login as the app's, marked as a staff attempt: it resolves to an identity with a moderator role and creates nothing. The browser returns to the panel with a one-time code in the URL fragment, or with error=admin_not_allowed.

schema.description: The language of the bank chooser; defaults to the request's.

parameters.description: The language of the bank chooser; defaults to the request's.
parameters.name: locale

post.summary: Exchange a staff one-time code for an admin session
post.description: Single use, within 60 seconds. Eight hours, no refresh; sign in again afterwards.

403.description: admin_not_allowed: the role was taken away meanwhile.

200.description: The role and when the session ends.

post.description: Erasure per TD-7: every session, login attempt, photo (with its objects unless another account shares them), review row and fetch log entry goes; the account row stays as an anonymised tombstone and the identity keeps a deletion count and a 30-day cooldown before a new account. The audit log is untouched. The body confirms; the app asks first.

204.description: Erased. Every token of this account has stopped working.

404.description: No live account: a second deletion that passed the session guard before the first committed (not_found).

get.summary: Everything Kuutti holds about this account
get.description: One JSON document: the account, the identity's dates and login level, the devices signed in, the photos with fifteen-minute URLs and their moderation outcome, and the person's own fetch log. Nothing about anyone else.
In the owner's order, with the blurhash to paint before the bytes arrive.

post.description: Multipart with one part named photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 10 MB). The API validates, strips metadata, re-encodes into three WebP variants and keeps no original. The photo is pending until moderation; the owner sees it, nobody else.

400.description: Validation failed (no photo part, or not an accepted type).

409.description: photo_limit: the account has max_photos photos already.

415.description: photo_unsupported: the bytes are not a JPEG, PNG or WebP.

422.description: photo_too_many_pixels or photo_invalid: refused before or by the decoder.

503.description: media_busy with Retry-After: image processing is at capacity; or media_unavailable.

204.description: Gone, along with its objects when nothing else shared them.

404.description: Not a photo of this account.

put.summary: Set the order of the photos
put.description: Position 0 is the main photo. Every photo of the account exactly once.

200.description: The photos in the new order.

get.summary: A signed URL for one variant
get.description: Valid for fifteen minutes. Every issuance is logged against the caller and counted against the day's budget for the variant (matching_config.photo_fetches_per_day; the day rolls at midnight in Finland). The app caches by photo id and variant, never by this URL, and asks for full only from the zoom screen. Another account's photo is served only from a card the caller was shown.

parameters.description: thumb: 200×200 for lists. card: 800×1067 when a profile is opened. full: 1600 px long edge, requested only from the zoom screen.
parameters.name: variant

200.description: The URL and when it stops working.

404.description: Not a photo this account may see: not its own, and not on a card it was shown.

429.description: photo_budget_exceeded: the day's fetches of this variant are used up; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

503.description: media_unavailable: no object storage is configured here.

get.summary: Photos waiting for a person's decision
get.description: Oldest first, with what the automatic check saw: labels with confidences, faces, what was flagged.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.summary: A signed URL for the card variant, for review
get.description: Any photo, any state. Every issuance is an audit_log row naming the member of staff.

200.description: The URL and when it stops working.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

503.description: media_unavailable: no object storage is configured here.

post.description: approve makes the photo visible to others; reject hides it and tells the owner the reason in words. Only a queued photo takes a decision, once. Only a person rejects. Written to audit_log.

400.description: Validation failed (a rejection without a reason, for example).

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

409.description: photo_not_queued: the photo is not waiting for a decision (already decided, or still being checked).

get.summary: The caller's profile and what it still needs
get.description: The profile as saved (null before the first save) and the completeness rule's verdict: what is missing before the profile can enter a round.

put.description: The whole document every time: display name, a bio or a placeholder, the fields from the registry, up to three prompts, and the special-category consent version when a field needs it. Free text passes the plain-text rule: no e-mail, URL, phone number or social handle.

200.description: Saved; the profile as stored, with its completeness.

400.description: Validation failed, or text_contact_details (a field carries an e-mail, URL, phone number or handle).

403.description: consent_required: a politics or religion answer without the consent of the current wording (ADR-019); the detail names the fields and the current version.

409.description: agreement_outdated: a consent version that is not the current wording's.

get.summary: The caller's own card, as others will see it
get.description: The card built the way a round builds it for someone else, with the age from the bank-verified year and month, the approved photos in order (bytes through GET /photos/{id}/{variant}) and what is still missing. Nothing is recorded: this is the owner looking at themselves.

200.description: The card, or null before the first save.

get.summary: What the caller has answered and what activation still waits for
get.description: Gender, pond, the two hard preferences, the consents given for the current wordings and the current versions. When nothing required is missing and the account is still registered, it becomes active here.

put.description: Self-declared, one of a closed list (rule 3); nothing from the bank informs it.

get.summary: Every consent the caller has given, and the current versions

post.summary: Record a consent for the current wording
post.description: The kind, the consent_version the person read and the language it was shown in. An old version is refused with agreement_outdated; the same consent twice is recorded once.

409.description: agreement_outdated: the wording has a newer version.

429.description: too_many_changes: the research opt-in was given and withdrawn more than the day allows.

delete.description: The one consent a person withdraws; terms and privacy end with the account. The rows stay as the record of what was agreed and when.

get.summary: Where the caller stands at the pond gate
get.description: Between a finished profile and the first round (TD-10): on the pond's waitlist with a place, let in and waiting for enough people who match (how many more, in steps of `step`), or open. Counted nightly, and once when a person with a finished profile first asks.

Per pond: bank-verified people waiting, their split by self-declared gender, and how many are finishing their profile. A number is published only where at least k people stand behind it (k is in the answer), the split only when every cell is at least k, and a pond's numbers move only once at least k people have come or gone since they were last said. Counted once a day. No session needed.

200.description: Every pond with what may be said of it.

get.summary: The ponds a person can choose
get.description: Every pond with both Finnish case forms (TD-17), parents first. Where matching happens (TD-10); the choice is one per account.

get.summary: Whom the caller seeks and the age window
get.description: The two hard filters of rule 7 as the person set them; null until onboarding sets them.

put.summary: Set whom the caller seeks and the age window
put.description: Both at once: a non-empty set of genders and an age window within 18 and 99 with min at most max. Hard rows: the round builder never crosses them, in either direction.
